name: GrafanaGitSyncPreview
description: Grafana Git Sync 'current' and 'preview' dashboard links for pull requests and branches.
helpMarkDown: Posts or updates one pull request comment with Grafana Git Sync preview links. [Docs](https://github.com/hayone1/azdo-grafana-git-sync-preview#readme)
author: Boluwatife Morawo

inputs.name: grafanaUrl
inputs.label: Grafana URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of the Grafana instance that runs Git Sync, for example `https://grafana.example.com`.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Mode

options.auto: Auto: pull request when built for one, otherwise branch
options.pullRequest: Pull request: changed dashboards, commented on the PR
options.branch: Branch: every dashboard, in the log and build summary

inputs.helpMarkDown: `pullRequest` lists dashboards the pull request changes and comments on it. `branch` lists every dashboard on the built branch in the log and the build summary, with no pull request needed.

inputs.name: organizations
inputs.label: Organizations
inputs.helpMarkDown:
One Grafana organization per line, as `orgId` or `label=orgId`. Every dashboard gets links for each organization. Example:
```
test=1
production=3
```

inputs.name: repositorySource
inputs.label: Repository definitions

options.file: Read from Repository manifests in this repo

inputs.helpMarkDown: How the task learns which folders Git Sync watches and the Grafana repository name for each.

inputs.name: repositoriesFile
inputs.label: Repository manifest files
inputs.helpMarkDown: One path or glob per line, relative to the repository root. Accepts Grafana `provisioning.grafana.app` `Repository` manifests and Crossplane `RepositoryV0Alpha1` managed resources. Multi-document YAML is supported.

inputs.name: repositories
inputs.label: Path mappings
inputs.helpMarkDown: One mapping per line, as `folder/in/repo=grafana-repository-name`. Use `.` or an empty folder for the repository root.

inputs.name: showCurrentLinks
inputs.label: Show 'current' links
inputs.helpMarkDown: Link to the live dashboard. Never shown for dashboards the pull request adds.

inputs.name: showPreviewLinks
inputs.label: Show 'preview' links
inputs.helpMarkDown: Link to Git Sync's preview of the file on the source branch. Never shown for deleted dashboards.

inputs.name: fileExtensions
inputs.label: File extensions
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated extensions treated as dashboard files.

inputs.name: commentTitle
inputs.label: Comment title
inputs.defaultValue: 📊 **Grafana dashboard changes in this pull request**
inputs.helpMarkDown: Markdown heading of the comment.

inputs.name: commentKey
inputs.label: Comment key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Hidden marker that identifies the comment to update. Give each task instance a different key to keep separate comments.

inputs.name: threadStatus
inputs.label: Thread status
inputs.helpMarkDown: Status of a new thread. `Closed` never blocks completion under a comment-resolution policy.

inputs.name: commentWhenNoChanges
inputs.label: Comment when no dashboards change
inputs.helpMarkDown: Post the comment even when the pull request changes no dashboard. An existing comment is always updated.

inputs.name: publishSummary
inputs.label: Publish build summary
inputs.helpMarkDown: Attach the dashboard table to the run's summary page, like a GitHub job summary.

inputs.name: summaryTitle
inputs.label: Branch summary title
inputs.helpMarkDown: Markdown heading of the build summary in branch mode. Defaults to a title naming the branch.

inputs.name: failOnParseError
inputs.label: Fail on unparseable dashboards
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the task when a changed dashboard file is invalid or has no uid. Otherwise the task succeeds with issues.

inputs.name: baseRevision
inputs.label: Base revision
inputs.helpMarkDown: Git revision to diff `HEAD` against. `HEAD^1` is the target branch in a pull request merge checkout. Use `origin/$(System.PullRequest.TargetBranchName)` when the pipeline checks out the source branch.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.label: Preview ref
inputs.helpMarkDown: Branch or tag Grafana previews. Defaults to the pull request source branch, or the built branch in branch mode.

inputs.name: syncedBranch
inputs.label: Synced branch
inputs.helpMarkDown: Branch Grafana syncs, used in branch mode to leave out 'current' links for dashboards that only exist on the built branch. When set, it wins over the `branch` in each Repository manifest. Defaults to that `branch`, then `main`.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Git checkout to inspect.

inputs.name: accessToken
inputs.label: Access token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Token that can contribute to pull requests. The build service identity needs **Contribute to pull requests** on the repository. In branch mode on Azure Repos, used only to fetch the synced branch.

outputVariables.name: dashboardCount
outputVariables.description: Number of changed dashboards listed in the comment.

outputVariables.name: parseErrorCount
outputVariables.description: Number of changed dashboard files that could not be parsed.
